scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c auto "npm run dev -w @portfolio/web" "npm run dev -w @portfolio/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio/api && npm run build -w @portfolio/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @portfolio/api && npm run lint -w @portfolio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/api && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/web
